name: tc-workflow
description: A Claude Code workflow for building software with agents: open and close each session, shape work (map, grill, prototype, spec), cut it into tickets kept in docs/TASKS.md or GitHub Issues, build test-first with subagents, nested sessions or implement-spec, check each branch with two fresh reviewers (code and function), merge on your own word, and prove the spec against production. Includes a credential guard, repo gates and a review policy.
